scope: Replay-only fixed-target critic fitting diagnostic; no policy release
frozen: same final full Gaussian actor, source alpha and target critic in both arms
initialCriticAndAdam: same populated final checkpoint, independently restored for each arm
targets: Once-only source Gaussian noise20261018; source epsilon-squash; frozen target twin minimum and alpha, gamma.97; mask0 targets BIT-EXACT reward; reused unchanged by both arms
split: Complete episodes0..509 only; episode%5==0 heldout, remaining train; final unfinished episode excluded; entire carried episode48 stays together

sampling.balanced: 64 training physical terminals plus64 training nonterminals, uniformly with replacement

selection: Fixed200-update endpoints; all outcomes retained; neither arm releases actor learning, new observation, policy promotion or physics
holdoutInterpretation: Separated only for these additional200-update fits: starting actor/critic already saw all5000 rows; this is closed-data calibration, not unseen-episode or physical generalization.
nonterminalMetricInterpretation: Regression to a single frozen bootstrap/noise target, not ground-truth value calibration or a policy advantage certificate.
